headline: Sweet spot bike: executed, compliant — load 58 vs 55 planned, RPE 4, clean recovery
summary: Indoor bike sweet spot done as scripted: interval log shows two clear ~10min reps around 155bpm (the third blends into a 15min/148bpm lap, likely a lap-marker miss rather than a missed rep — avg HR across the whole 54min session was 144bpm, consistent with 3x10min work + easy spin between). Load landed at 58 vs 55 estimated, essentially exact for a steady aerobic session (no icu undercount here, that only shows up on short high-intensity work). RPE 4, feel 1 (best possible), HRR 23bpm in 60s off a 166bpm peak — no fatigue signal at all. This morning's wellness is the standout: HRV 79, well above the 42-67 range of the last two weeks, RHR 47 (normal), sleep score 80. TSB sits at +0.8, basically neutral after nine days climbing out of the -17 post-Pirin hole. Zero-impact aerobic load landed exactly as intended, no adjustment needed to the rest of this week (Thu easy+strides, Fri gym+spin, Sat Presolana long run, Sun recovery jog) — today's HRV spike is a green light to hold Saturday's Z3 climb finish as planned rather than needing to cut it.
suggestedChange: None for this week. Wk3 (28 Sep-4 Oct) has been redesigned around confirmed availability (Tue 80min quality, Wed Bucharest-travel easy day, Thu/Fri Bucharest long runs, Sat/Sun back-to-back at home) — pushed to the tracker today.
